name: SENASIC Electronics Technology Co., Ltd.
summary: SENASIC Electronics Technology Co., Ltd., through its subsidiaries, engages in design, research and development, and sales of chip products in China. Its products include intelligent tire sensing SoCs, BMS SoCs, wBMS SoCs, USI SoCs, and USS SoCs. It also offers sensor SoC platform that integrates sensing, processing and wireless transmission capabilities; wireless radio frequency technologies; automotive-grade capabilities; and engineering capabilities. The company products are used in applications, such as telecommunications, energy storage, automotive, industrial electronics, and robotics.
